title: Urumuri ruri mu ngoro y'ubwibone
intro: Inyuma y'inkuta nini z'ingoro ikomeye cyane mu isi ya kera, hari umuntu wari ufite umutima wari ufite ibanga nta tegeko ry'umwami ryashoboraga gucecekesha. Mu gihe bose bari bamukikije basengaga imana z'ibinyoma, uwo muntu yagumanye ukwizera gutuje imbere. Umutware w'icyo gihugu yibwiraga ko ari Imana, nyamara uwo muntu yahisemo ukuri kuruta ihumure, no kwiyegurira Imana kuruta umutekano. Uyu munsi, inshingano yawe ni ukumenya uwo uwo muntu w'intwari yari we, inkuru ye ikaba imwe mu ngero zikomeye z'ukwizera kudacogora.
clues: Nabaga ahantu hari ubutunzi butagira uko bungana kandi h’icyubahiro kitagereranywa, aho umutegetsi w’igihugu yari afite ububasha busesuye kuri byose.
Mu gihe abari banyikikije bapfukamiraga imana z'ibinyoma, nakomeje kugira urumuri rw'ukwemera mu mutima wanjye.
Navumbuye umwana kandi ndamurera wazanywe kuri njye mu buryo budasanzwe - atari ukuvuka, ahubwo namukuye mu mazi y'uruzi runini.
Nasenze Umwami wanjye, nsaba gutura hafi ye muri Paradizo no gukizwa igitugu cyari kimkikije.
Umwana nareze yakuze agerageza guhangana n'umutegetsi wagenzuraga ibyambayeho, kandi nakomeje kwizera nubwo nageramiwe.
Ndi uwo izina rye ryiyubashye muri Korowani nk'icyitegererezo cy'ukwemera, kandi nabaye mu ngoro ya Farawo ubwe.

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
